sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's downstream nickel-processing ban continues to force global smelting capacity onshore, structurally supporting domestic miner margins and M&A premiums.
China's fiscal reflation and grid buildout are re-rating coal and base-metal demand, with Indonesian exporters capturing spot-price upside faster than global peers.
Government-mandated domestic market obligations and new royalty tiers are raising entry barriers, consolidating the sector toward large-cap incumbents with logistics and power assets.
sectors.ai: Buy selectively into high-beta nickel and coal names (ALKA, PSAB, MBMA) on the back of China stimulus and tight Indonesian supply, but take profits into strength on AMMN and BRMS as valuations stretch. Rotate into SGER and TPL for defensive thermal-coal cash flows.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesian EV value-chain names (VKTR, TOBA) are compounding on domestic nickel smelting and bus electrification mandates, decoupling from US rate cycles.
Biomass and geothermal operators (NRG, ESSA) benefit from PLN's baseload substitution program, securing long-term PPAs that stabilize cash flows.
US renewable utilities (CEG, BEP) face margin compression from falling power prices and higher financing costs, making them tactical shorts versus ID longs.
sectors.ai: Buy VKTR and TOBA for domestic EV/battery supply-chain momentum, and add NRG for biomass-to-power upside; trim US-exposed CEG/BEP given rate-sensitive headwinds. Rotate into Indonesian names with local offtake and policy tailwinds, targeting 5-8% alpha over 3 months while hedging global clean-energy beta.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Ramadan and Lebaran consumption cycles drive outsized FMCG volume spikes in Q1-Q2, rewarding early positioning in food, beverage, and personal-care names.
Palm-oil price strength and downstream diversification lift plantation-linked consumer plays (BWPT, PGUN), offering a hedge against rupiah volatility.
Small-cap liquidity rotation favors micro-cap FMCG names with low float and high retail participation, amplifying momentum but raising reversal risk.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small-cap consumer names with confirmed volume breakouts (BRRC, COIN, JARR) while avoiding laggards; the ID/US divergence signals domestic demand strength, so rotate into local staples and palm-oil-linked plays (BWPT, PGUN) ahead of Ramadan restocking.
